import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Daily Steps, colored by Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=data,
    x='Daily Steps',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Quality of Sleep',
    palette='coolwarm',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(20, 200),
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolor='w'
)

# Add axis labels and title
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_title('Relationship between Daily Steps and Sleep Duration\nColored by Quality of Sleep', fontsize=14)

# Add legend
scatter_plot.legend(title='Quality of Sleep', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
